settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace-level preferences and demo data controls.
settings.languageSubtitle: Choose the interface language for this browser.
settings.modulesSubtitle: Enable only the parts this organization actually uses.
settings.modulesHint: Disabling a module hides its navigation, command-palette entries, public entry points, and guarded routes. Existing data stays in place and becomes available again if you re-enable the module later.
settings.logoSubtitle: Shown in the sidebar. Exported documents use the letterhead below.
settings.inventoryPrompt: Prompt for current count when adding consumables
settings.demoToggle: Show demo banner and allow seeding a fake society
settings.logoFormats: SVG, PNG, or JPG. Max 2 MB.
settings.logoDarkHint: By default, the same logo is used in both themes.
settings.letterheadHint: Header image for exported minutes, meeting packs, and the public copy.
settings.sidebarSubtitle: Choose which sidebar sections show in your workspace.
settings.aiSubtitle: Show or hide the in-app AI chat features.
settings.aiToggleHint: When off, the sidebar bot button and the floating AI assistant are removed. Other AI-driven helpers (e.g. transcript generation) stay available.
settings.inventorySubtitle: Controls for asset and consumable workflows.
settings.inventoryPromptHint: When adding stock to a consumable item, ask how many are left first, then add the new amount to that observed count.
settings.notificationsSubtitle: Controls for the in-app notification center.
settings.modulesAccessNote: Modules are workspace-wide feature switches. User access follows workspace roles.
settings.modulesOwnerOnly: Only an Owner or Admin can change these settings.

onDeviceAi.title: On-device AI
onDeviceAi.subtitle: Use a model server on this computer for minutes drafts, the assistant and AI intake.
onDeviceAi.demoNotice: The demo never contacts a network service, so on-device AI is turned off here. Open a local workspace or the desktop app to connect Ollama, LM Studio or llama.cpp.
onDeviceAi.enableHint: Server workspaces use the workspace AI provider instead.
onDeviceAi.addressHint: Prefilled with the usual address. Change it if your server uses another port.
onDeviceAi.addressOther: The server's OpenAI-compatible address, usually ending in /v1.
onDeviceAi.privacy: Requests go only to the address above. With a local server, meeting data stays on this computer.
onDeviceAi.notSynced: These settings stay on this device and are not part of the workspace or its exports.
onDeviceAi.modelPick: Pick one of the server's models or type a name.
onDeviceAi.modelHint: Test the connection to list the server's models, or type a name such as llama3.1:8b.
onDeviceAi.keyStored: A key is stored in {{place}}. Enter a new one to replace it.
onDeviceAi.keyRequiredHint: Kept in {{place}}; never saved to the workspace.
onDeviceAi.keyLocalHint: Not needed for a server on this computer. If you set one, it is kept in {{place}}.
onDeviceAi.keyPlaceDesktop: the operating system keychain on this computer
onDeviceAi.keyPlaceBrowser: this browser tab only (cleared when the tab closes)
onDeviceAi.featureAssistant: The assistant chat and Ask AI table filters
onDeviceAi.featureAssistantHint: The assistant works from what you paste or attach, unless record lookups are on below.
onDeviceAi.toolsLookUp: Let the assistant look up workspace records
onDeviceAi.toolsLookUpHint: Read-only: meetings, minutes, transcripts, documents, tasks, deadlines and commitments, limited to what you can see (in-camera content stays withheld as usual). Lookups run on this device; what the assistant reads is sent only to the model server above.
onDeviceAi.toolsPropose: Allow the assistant to propose changes
onDeviceAi.toolsProposeHint: It can propose new tasks. Nothing changes until you approve each proposal in the chat.
onDeviceAi.chunkHint: Longer transcripts are drafted in parts and combined, for models with small context windows. 8,000 suits a 4k-token model.
onDeviceAi.testOk: Connected in {{ms}} ms. The server offers {{models}} model(s).
